dog.description_text: Nala is a beautiful girl with the cutest little face! She can be shy when first meeting new people and will appreciate a gentle, patient approach as she gets comfortable. She is a curious, food-motivated girl who is slowly coming out of her shell in the care center and beginning to warm up to staff and enjoy affection.
